name: What should I do first if my bathroom is getting harder or unsafe to use?
description: Start by identifying the hardest daily tasks, then schedule an in-home assessment so the bathroom can be evaluated for safety, space, and support needs.

mainEntity.name: What should I do first if my bathroom is getting harder or unsafe to use?

acceptedAnswer.text: The fastest way to start is to focus on the specific bathroom tasks that feel unsafe or hardest to do, then request an in-home assessment so the layout, plumbing, and wall support can be reviewed together. For many projects, that first visit determines whether a simple safety update or a fuller remodel is the right fix.
